statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 11 sits in the low band while Stress 46 remains elevated; the published danger window spans 12:30Z-15:00Z.
recommendation: The deterministic mapping holds at EA_ON because the defining overnight observation remains a completed retracement rather than a one-way path: the post-earnings spike to 29,654.75 was given back in full to 29,401.75, that marginal new low was rejected, and price has since recovered to roughly 29,619. Tail is lifted a single point from the previous assessment to acknowledge that NQ now sits in the upper part of the range close to the session extreme, which is one of the listed amplifiers, but a single amplifier following a completed 253-point give-back does not describe a path in which mean reversion fails. Cross-assets supply no confirmation: VIX is near 14.86 and down about 2.3%, crude is in a fourth consecutive daily decline on Strait of Hormuz diplomacy, and the last published constant-maturity yields are unchanged. The forward path lifts Tail into the WATCH band only for the 13:00Z and 14:00Z hours covering the U.S. cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing, and the published danger window is kept narrow at 12:30Z-15:00Z around the claims release and that opening sequence. Stress stays elevated on the hawkish rates backdrop and Friday's Jackson Hole keynote rather than on any observed failure of mean reversion.
headline: Overnight give-back complete and NQ back near the range high: Tail edges to 11, Stress 46 into jobless claims and the Nvidia cash-open repricing
body: Nasdaq-100 September futures trade near 29,618.75, up roughly 329 points or 1.12%, as of 08:16Z against a previous close of 29,289.50, with an overnight range of 29,401.75 to 29,654.75. A second independent quote at 08:17Z shows 29,607.75, up 1.09%. The structural observation that governs this assessment is unchanged: the impulse that followed Nvidia's results was fully retraced before the market advanced again. Price reached 29,654.75 after the release, gave back about 253 points to a marginal new overnight low of 29,401.75, and has since recovered roughly 217 points to sit in the upper part of the range, still a little below the high rather than printing new extremes. That is a two-sided path containing a completed retracement, which is the opposite of the persistent no-retracement structure Tail measures. Tail is raised by one point only because price now holds nearer the session extreme, a single amplifier without cross-asset confirmation. Nvidia reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year, with data-centre revenue of $89.0 billion, GAAP diluted earnings of $2.46 and third-quarter guidance of about $108 billion, and management's first-ever year-ahead outlook pointed to roughly 70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028 against an analyst average nearer 44%. Cross-asset context does not supply an amplifier. VIX trades near 14.86, down about 2.3% from a 15.21 close and sitting at the low of its own day range. WTI is near $81.53 and Brent near $87.38, both in a fourth consecutive daily decline as Iran and Oman negotiate a framework for reopening transit through the Strait of Hormuz, a de-escalation direction rather than a discontinuity. The most recent H.15 constant-maturity readings place the 2-year at 4.17%, the 10-year at 4.64% and the 30-year at 5.17%. The macro backdrop remains the main source of Stress rather than Tail: July PCE published Wednesday showed the headline index up 0.2% on the month and 3.7% year over year with core up 0.2% and 3.3% year over year, leaving September rate pricing unsettled ahead of Friday's Jackson Hole keynote, whose timing has been verified for 10:00 ET, or 14:00Z, on 28 August. The shared Finviz cross-asset context file carried a collection timestamp of 02:15Z, more than six hours old at this assessment and therefore outside the freshness bound, so it was not used as confirming evidence and the assessment rests on independently fetched primary sources. Confidence is set at 87 on two independent current futures quotes, a current VIX reading, current crude prices, the latest published H.15 yields, verified company results and a verified event calendar, tempered by the stale shared context file and by the one-day lag inherent in the H.15 release.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 hours Claude held Tail between 10 and 16 through the Wednesday European and U.S. sessions while Stress climbed from 53 to 61 as the market positioned into July PCE and the Nvidia print. Tail stepped to 21 and status to yellow for the 20:00Z hour containing the earnings release, then decayed steadily through 18, 16, 13, 12, 11 and 10 as the reaction proved two-sided rather than one-way, with Stress unwinding from 66 back to 45. Two hourly slots, 21:00Z on 26 August and 00:00Z on 27 August, have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. The dominant mode moved from normal through event/whipsaw around the release and back to mixed as the overnight retracement completed and the low was rejected.
outlookSummary: The forward window holds Tail at 11 through the European morning on the observation that the post-earnings spike has already been retraced in full and the overnight low rejected, with price recovering toward but not through the high. It rises to 12 in the final pre-release hour, to 15 for the hour containing initial jobless claims at 12:30Z, and to 20 for the cash-open hour and the first full cash hour, the only stretch mapped to WATCH, because an opening auction repricing a large megacap gap is the setup most capable of producing continuation with shallow pullbacks. That structure is explicitly unobserved and conditional. From 15:00Z the path decays through 16, 14, 13 and 12 as the event stack clears, with a one-point lift for the closing hour to reflect month-end-adjacent imbalance flow. Overnight values fall to a floor of 9 between the U.S. close and the Tokyo session, then rebuild through 10 and 11 to 12 by the final hour as pre-event hedging into Friday's Jackson Hole keynote begins. Stress follows the same shape from 46 up to 58 around the open, down to 38 overnight and back to 49, staying elevated on the hawkish rates backdrop rather than on any observed failure of mean reversion. Confidence declines gradually across the overnight block because the evidence behind this forecast ages with each hour. The keynote at 14:00Z on 28 August falls outside this window and will be scored by a later assessment.
